_: The start line, standing on the grid behind the Dino.
Every number here is the game's own start template, identical on every
course (verified live on BEAC in a C2C race and on PALM/BEAC in the two
OUTRUN tours; the writeup's Part XXXVIII has the derivation):
SCALE. OutRun's world units are metres — the Dino's wheelbase in the
chassis table is 2.34 m, the real car's to a centimetre — so
metresPerUnit is 1.
CAR. The grid slot: the physics body rests at (0, 0.30, -15.72) with
identity rotation; the MODEL frame (ground-origin, nose toward -z, the
direction of travel) sits at (0, 0, -16.0) — pinned by the driver
record at 0x59D6D0, whose world position equals car frame + the
chassis seat anchor exactly, on both verified courses.
SEATS. The chassis record's two attach points at +0x108 (default.xbe,
Dino record) are HIP TARGETS, car-local: driver (-0.318, 0.614,
0.257), passenger (0.314, 0.614, 0.292). The sitting clips carry
their own hip height in character space (SUWARI kosi rides at 0.613
= the anchor's 0.614, measured in both), so the character ORIGIN
goes on the floor at the anchor's x/z and the pose lands the hips
on the anchor. The driver plays the grid sitting loop; the
passenger is Heart Attack's ride-along, bouncing her excited
TUNTUN loop.
SPAWN. The race camera idles a few metres behind the car: floor spawn
7 m behind the rear bumper, looking down the course (-z), standing eye
height lands where the game's own chase camera sits.
MUSIC. Splash Wave, the OutRun2 tour's opening track.
_fog: Distance fog doing double duty: atmosphere AND the render budget. The
course ships chunked (300 m world-geometry cells, each tagged with its
bounds), and world mode culls every chunk wholly beyond fog.far —
pop-free by construction, a fragment past far is pure fog colour
before its chunk vanishes. The colour is this stage's own sky
average (sampled from its sky-dome textures), so the fog wall reads
as haze against the horizon. The game's own scn_env_fog is
exponential at ~1.5e-4 (a clear day) — a Quest 3 cannot afford the
clear day; this trades draw distance for frame rate.
